@atomic
def object_picked_up(
    env,
    object: str,
    surface: str,
    distance: float = 0.05,
    env_id: int | None = None,
):
    """Check if object is grabbed and lifted at least `distance` above the surface."""
    result = _and(
        object_grabbed(env, object, env_id=env_id),
        object_above(env, object=object, reference_object=surface, env_id=env_id, z_margin=distance)
    )
    if robolab.constants.DEBUG:
        print(f"object_picked_up: '{object}' grabbed and lifted {distance}m above '{surface}' -> {result}")
    return result

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate one replayable cube-to-the-left-of-bowl trajectory."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+s = Session("rubiks_cube_left_of_bowl", instance="/app/instance.json")
+p = s.primitives()
+
+try:
+    print("initial", json.dumps(s.objects(), sort_keys=True))
+    print("reset_tcp", s.ee_pose())
+    print("finger_close_dir", p["get_finger_closing_dir"]())
+    s.reset()
+    s.record_start()
+
+    cube = s.objects()["rubiks_cube"]
+    bounds = np.asarray(cube["bounds"], dtype=float)
+    grasp_xy = bounds.mean(axis=0)[:2]
+    q = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+    print("grasp_xy", grasp_xy, "orientation", q)
+
+    # Come in well above the cube, then bring the finger tips down alongside it.
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=4)
+    p["move_ee"]([grasp_xy[0], grasp_xy[1], 0.17], q, speed=0.18, settle=3)
+    p["move_ee"]([grasp_xy[0], grasp_xy[1], 0.055], q, speed=0.08, settle=3)
+    p["close_gripper"](steps=24)
+    p["hold"](8)
+    print("after_grasp", s.objects()["rubiks_cube"], s.ee_pose(), s.status())
+
+    # Lift clear of the bowl, translate, and place on the table with its origin
+    # well to the robot's +y side of the bowl.
+    p["move_ee"]([grasp_xy[0], grasp_xy[1], 0.22], q, speed=0.12, settle=5)
+    p["move_ee"]([0.42, 0.30, 0.22], q, speed=0.18, settle=4)
+    p["move_ee"]([0.42, 0.30, 0.055], q, speed=0.08, settle=4)
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=18)
+    p["hold"](20)
+    p["move_ee"]([0.42, 0.30, 0.20], q, speed=0.12, settle=5)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    print("live_final", s.objects()["rubiks_cube"], s.objects()["bowl"], s.status(), "actions", actions.shape)
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"description": "top-down grasp and place left of bowl"})
+    print("saved", OUT / "trajectory.npz")
+
+    # The first in-process replay is a useful exact check, in addition to the
+    # required fresh-process replay run separately.
+    print("inprocess_replay", s.replay(actions))
+finally:
+    # Keep simulator teardown after the trajectory has been written.
+    s.close()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
